content:
Oasis branding

Custom Oasis/Firefox Oasis visuals and naming; Help and feedback links route to Kahana (app.support.baseURL, app.feedback.baseURL) instead of Mozilla defaults.

What this is

Oasis is a customized Firefox-based browser. Help, feedback, and some policy links point to Kahana instead of Mozilla’s default pages so support matches your Oasis subscription and product.

How to use it

  • Use Help from the application menu to open Kahana documentation.
  • Use Submit feedback (or the feedback survey link in the product) for Oasis-specific issues.
  • Expect Oasis naming and visuals (toolbar, assistant, welcome) rather than stock Firefox branding.

Notes and limits

Some deep links still reference Mozilla technology (engine, security). Oasis-specific policy text lives on Kahana.
